diagnosis.headline: Your wallet does not hold enough USDC: it has 0 USDC and the transaction needed 1,000,000,000 USDC.
diagnosis.why: The transaction tried to move 1,000,000,000 USDC out of your wallet, but that wallet only held 0 USDC when it ran. The token contract does not allow spending more than a wallet holds, so it stopped the transaction.
fix: Your wallet holds no USDC: add at least 1,000,000,000 USDC before trying to send that much.
Check the amount's decimals: a value typed in whole tokens must be multiplied by the token's decimals before sending.
evidence: replayed with eth_call at block 31560414 (the state the transaction started from), same sender, value, data and gas limit
token error ERC20InsufficientBalance(sender=0x317bca01Bb101C0F1E86C21576a4e14D92B02975, balance=0, needed=1000000000000000) at block 31560414
